messages.subject: [adegenet-forum] adegenet Xmas release
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

it is admittedly a lame present, but here it is: a new version of adegenet has been released on CRAN. It includes a new version of propShared which fixes a bug and is now faster and more general (applies to any ploidy level).

Sources for linux are already on CRAN; binaries for deviant systems will be available within a day or two - delivered by Santa in person.

Enjoy you holiday break, and best wishes for the new coming year!

Best regards

Thibaut
